你是一个乐于助人的 AI 助手。

只输出一个 JSON 对象：{"reply": "给买家的回复全文"}

messages.content:
我是做小家电的外贸业务员，帮我回复这条阿里巴巴国际站的询盘，用买家的语言，尽量拿下订单：

Hello, I manage procurement for a 40-property hotel group in Florida. We plan to place one garment steamer in each guest room, about 3,200 units in total, delivered in two lots in Q1. Please quote FOB Ningbo by sea for 3,000+ units, and confirm whether the unit has ETL or UL. We normally pay by L/C at sight. Could you also send 2 samples to our Orlando office? Regards, Dana Whitfield, Procurement Manager

content:
{"reply": "Dear Dana,

Thank you for your inquiry and for considering us for your hotel group's guest-room garment steamer project. A rollout of about 3,200 units across 40 properties is the kind of hospitality order we handle well, and we would be glad to support you from samples through both Q1 deliveries.

1. Quotation (FOB Ningbo, by sea)
- Model: [Model No.], [handheld / standing] garment steamer, 120V/60Hz, US plug, [wattage]W
- Unit price: USD [X.XX]/unit for 3,000+ units
- Packing: [units per carton], carton size [L x W x H cm], [units per 20GP/40HQ container]
- Production lead time: [XX] days after L/C receipt and sample approval
- Price validity: [XX] days

For 3,200 units in two lots, we suggest about [1,600] units per lot, or a split that matches your property opening schedule. Please share your target arrival dates in Florida and your preferred port of discharge (for example, Jacksonville, Miami or Port Everglades), and we will plan production and shipping to meet them.

2. Certification
[Option A: This model is ETL/UL listed under file No. [XXXX]. We will send the certificate with the samples and can share it by email beforehand.]
[Option B: This model is currently not ETL/UL listed. We can arrange ETL certification for your order, which takes about [X] weeks and costs about USD [X]. We can also recommend a comparable model that is already certified. Please let us know which you prefer.]

3. Payment
We accept L/C at sight. Please send us your draft L/C terms in advance so we can confirm the documentary requirements and avoid any discrepancies.

4. Samples
We will be happy to send 2 samples to your Orlando office. [The samples are free of charge, and we will cover express shipping.] / [The sample cost is USD [X], refundable against your bulk order, and courier freight is about USD [X], or you may provide your courier account.] Please confirm your full delivery address, recipient name and phone number. We can dispatch within [X] working days of confirmation.

5. Hotel-specific options
We can also offer:
- Automatic shut-off and anti-dry-boil protection for guest safety
- Custom logo and branded gift box
- Wall-mount bracket or storage bag for in-room placement
- Spare parts and a [X]-year warranty with replacement support

To finalize the offer, could you tell us whether you prefer a handheld or standing unit, whether you need custom branding, and the target delivery date for each lot?

We look forward to working with you and your properties.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Title] | [Company Name]
Email: [email] | WhatsApp/Tel: [number]
[Website]"}
